results.title: UN General Assembly opens with Macron, Trump, Erdogan, Lula, others in NYC
results.description: Donald Trump hailed his own record and hinted at a chance for peace in Iran and Ukraine. Turkey's president called for more pressure on Israel. UN leaders called for more global interdependence. DW has the latest.

results.title: UN General Assembly opens with Trump, Lula, others in NYC
results.description: World leaders have begun gathering in New York for the UN General Assembly. US President Trump will address the body on Tuesday, as will his Finnish, French and Turkish counterparts. Follow DW for the latest.
